tldr: 颱風巴威來襲，台北股市、匯市與期貨全日休市，即使藍籌財報大量出爐、交易仍暫停一天。
AI 記憶體熱潮橫掃太平洋兩岸——環球晶拿下美光十年長約、SK 海力士赴美掛牌超額認購七倍，晶片股並無視美伊再度交火而走強。
台灣 6 月出口年增 40.3%、創歷年最強 6 月；亞銀上修台灣今年成長率至 9.5% 稱冠亞太，但新台幣重貶至逾一年低點。
金融版圖持續重塑：金管會核准永豐併京城銀、玉山取得三商美邦人壽百分百股權，青安 3.0 也將自 8 月起分級限縮申貸資格。
華爾街憂「美股七雄」熄火、改由 AI 晶片供應鏈新族群撐盤；Apollo 警告 AI 回報若延後，恐將經濟推向衰退。

items.title_zh: 巴威颱風來襲　台股全日休市
items.title_en: Taiwan markets shut for the day as Typhoon Bavi approaches
items.summary_zh: 台北市政府宣布公教機關停止上班後，臺灣證券交易所與櫃買中心公告 7 月 10 日集中市場、櫃買、匯市與期貨市場全日休市，當日應屆交割款券順延辦理，聯詠、中信金等 23 檔個股除權息也一併延後。這場臨時休市，正好卡在大量 6 月營收與上半年財報密集公布之際，投資人只能先消化財報、待下一個交易日開盤後才能反映，短線資金動能與除息行情因而遞延，颱風過後的補漲補跌動向成為觀察重點。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and Taipei Exchange announced that the cash equity, over-the-counter, FX and futures markets will all close on July 10 after Taipei City ordered public offices shut for the typhoon. Settlement of trades due that day is postponed, and ex-dividend dates for 23 stocks including Novatek and CTBC Financial are pushed back. The unscheduled break freezes trading just as a wave of June revenue and first-half earnings hits the tape, leaving investors to digest results without a chance to react until the market reopens.

items.title_zh: 台塑四寶上半年大賺逾千億　南亞 EPS 5.17 元居冠
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics group's "big four" earn over NT$100bn in first half
items.summary_zh: 台塑四寶第 2 季稅後純益合計 642.76 億元，季增 45.5%，並擺脫去年同期虧損，上半年合計獲利達 1,084.53 億元，其中南亞每股稅後盈餘 5.17 元最亮眼。展望第 3 季，隨美伊停火、荷姆茲海峽重啟、中東原料供應回穩，台塑預估開工率將自第 2 季 62% 升至 73%，但因石化傳統旺季效應，全季業績仍可能略低於第 2 季。這波獲利回升，顯示傳產景氣正逐步走出去年外銷谷底，也為下半年原物料族群定調。
items.summary_en: The four core Formosa Plastics companies reported combined second-quarter after-tax profit of NT$64.28bn, up 45.5% sequentially and reversing a year-earlier loss, lifting first-half net profit to NT$108.45bn. Nan Ya Plastics led with EPS of NT$5.17. Management expects Q3 plant utilisation to rise to 73% from 62% as the Strait of Hormuz reopens and Middle-East feedstock supply normalises, though seasonal petrochemical demand means Q3 results may dip from Q2. The rebound signals traditional-sector cyclicals are climbing out of last year's export trough.

items.title_zh: 台達電 6 月營收創高　AI 電源、散熱出貨旺
items.title_en: Delta Electronics posts record June revenue on AI power demand
items.summary_zh: 電源龍頭台達電 6 月合併營收 656.03 億元，改寫單月歷史新高，月增 11.3%、年增 55.4%，主要受惠 AI 相關電源及散熱產品出貨熱潮，第 2 季與上半年營收同創新高。隨營運邁入傳統旺季，法人看好台達電業績可望續攻高峰。這份成績單再度印證，AI 伺服器建置帶動的效益已從晶片端外溢至電源、散熱與零組件供應鏈，而台灣廠商正是這波電力基礎設施升級的核心受惠者，也讓台達電成為 AI 硬體投資的重要指標股。
items.summary_en: Power-supply leader Delta Electronics reported June consolidated revenue of NT$65.6bn, an all-time monthly high, up 11.3% on the month and 55.4% on the year, driven by shipments of AI-related power and thermal-management products. Second-quarter and first-half revenue also set records. With the business now entering its traditional peak season, analysts expect Delta's momentum to continue building. The result underscores how AI-server buildouts are flowing beyond chipmakers into the power, cooling and components supply chain that Taiwan dominates.

items.title_zh: 大立光奪首張 CPO 訂單　Q3 產能滿載
items.title_en: Largan wins first co-packaged optics order, Q3 lines run full
items.summary_zh: 光學鏡頭廠大立光在法說會證實，共同封裝光學（CPO）新事業已取得首張訂單，有客戶期望光纖陣列（FA）量產，本月送樣、將以最快速度認證，預計最快明年中量產。董事長林恩平表示，7 月拉貨動能比 6 月好、8 月又更旺，本季產能利用率將滿載。這張訂單象徵大立光正式切入 AI 驅動的光通訊、共封裝光學商機，該領域是解決次世代資料中心頻寬與能耗瓶頸的關鍵戰場，也讓大立光在既有手機鏡頭本業之外，開闢一條與 AI 算力連動的成長曲線。
items.summary_en: Optical-lens maker Largan Precision confirmed at its earnings call that its co-packaged optics (CPO) new business has secured its first order, with a customer seeking fibre-array (FA) mass-production volumes; samples ship this month for fast-track certification, targeting mass production by mid-2027. Chairman Lin En-ping said July pull-in momentum is better than June and August better still, with Q3 utilisation set to run at full capacity. The order marks Largan's entry into the AI-driven optical-interconnect race central to next-generation data-centre bandwidth.

items.title_zh: 日月光 Q2 營收創高　力積電衝 47 個月新高
items.title_en: ASE hits record Q2 revenue; Powerchip revenue at 47-month high
items.summary_zh: 封測大廠日月光投控 6 月營收 657.83 億元，月增 4.4%、年增 32.9%，第 2 季營收 1,910.64 億元、季增 10.0%，改寫單季新高。晶圓代工廠力積電 6 月營收 64.74 億元，月增 12.2%、年增 68.75%，創近 47 個月新高，第 2 季營收 172.9 億元、季增 27.4%，為 15 季以來高點。兩家業者財報同步走揚，反映先進封裝與成熟製程代工需求皆維持強勁，AI 與記憶體相關訂單持續在台灣半導體供應鏈擴散，也為下半年封測與晶圓代工景氣提供支撐。
items.summary_en: Packaging-and-test giant ASE Technology reported June revenue of NT$65.78bn, up 4.4% on the month and 32.9% on the year, with second-quarter revenue of NT$191.06bn rising 10.0% sequentially to a record. Separately, foundry Powerchip posted June revenue of NT$6.47bn, up 68.75% year-on-year and a 47-month high, with Q2 revenue up 27.4% sequentially. Both results reflect resilient demand across advanced packaging and mature-node foundry as AI and memory-related orders ripple through Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain.

items.title_zh: 環球晶拿下美光 10 年長約　並取得 5 億美元策略資金
items.title_en: GlobalWafers lands 10-year Micron supply deal and $500m in strategic funding
items.summary_zh: 矽晶圓大廠環球晶與美光共同宣布深化長期策略合作、強化美國半導體製造，簽訂 10 年長約，美光將提供約 5 億美元策略性資金支持環球晶美國業務並提升供應能力。董事長徐秀蘭表示，因美光長單具一定量能，德州廠第二期規劃勢必啟動，也將增加在美資本支出。此案被稱為環球晶史上最長、金額最大的合約，不僅鎖定十年穩定需求，也讓環球晶深度綁定美國記憶體供應鏈重組與在地化生產趨勢，為半導體關鍵材料供應韌性再添籌碼。
items.summary_en: Silicon-wafer maker GlobalWafers and U.S. memory giant Micron jointly announced a deepened long-term partnership to strengthen American semiconductor manufacturing. Under the 10-year agreement, Micron will provide about US$500m in strategic funding to support GlobalWafers' U.S. business and boost supply capacity. Chairwoman Doris Hsu said the committed volumes mean the second phase of the company's Texas plant will proceed, inevitably raising U.S. capital spending. The deal is described as the longest and largest contract in GlobalWafers' history and anchors its position in reshoring the U.S. chip-materials supply chain.

items.title_zh: 台積電引爆矽光子革命　PIC 產能三年擴增 30 倍
items.title_en: TSMC accelerates silicon-photonics push, PIC capacity to grow 30x in three years
items.summary_zh: 隨全球 AI 算力競賽白熱化，資料傳輸頻寬與能耗成為技術瓶頸。為因應次世代高效能運算需求，台積電正加速布局矽光子與共封裝光學（CPO），據傳其光子積體電路（PIC）產能三年內將擴增約 30 倍，帶動 CPO 供應鏈自 2026 年起邁入商業化元年。這波布局將把光通訊、封裝與光學元件台廠一併納入受惠圈，並牽動 AI 資料中心以更低功耗完成晶片間資料傳輸的架構革新，成為半導體下一階段成長主軸；相關矽光子、CPO 概念股後續動能值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: As the global AI compute race intensifies, data-transmission bandwidth and energy consumption have become key bottlenecks. To meet next-generation high-performance-computing needs, TSMC is speeding up its build-out of silicon photonics and co-packaged optics (CPO), with reports that its photonic integrated circuit (PIC) capacity will expand roughly 30-fold over three years. The move positions 2026-onward as the commercialisation era for CPO supply chains, drawing in Taiwanese optical-component and packaging vendors and reshaping how AI data centres move data between chips at lower power.

items.title_zh: 經濟部砸 230 億輔導產業 AI　拚 2028 年逾 2 萬家導入
items.title_en: Ministry earmarks NT$23bn to steer industry AI transformation
items.summary_zh: 經濟部整合旗下各單位兩年約 230 億元 AI 轉型預算，成立「產業競爭力輔導團」，依企業需求分三階段協助導入 AI。截至 6 月底，輔導團已協助 9,249 家企業導入 AI 應用，範圍從螺帽廠到早餐店，目標 2028 年輔導突破 2 萬家、AI 普及率達 50%，帶動 500 億元產值。此舉將 AI 應用從大型科技業向下擴散至傳統中小企業，盼藉由政策資源與投資媒合縮短數位落差，讓 AI 轉型成為全產業競爭力升級的共同基礎，也回應企業對導入成本與人才不足的長期痛點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs has consolidated about NT$23bn of two-year AI-transformation budget across its agencies and set up an "Industrial Competitiveness Advisory Corps" to help firms adopt AI in three stages. As of end-June the corps had already helped 9,249 companies deploy AI applications, ranging from a nut-and-bolt maker to a breakfast chain. The ministry targets more than 20,000 firms assisted and 50% AI penetration by 2028, aiming to drive NT$50bn in added output value and broaden AI diffusion beyond large tech into traditional small and medium enterprises.

items.title_zh: 工業富聯發布業績預增　上半年獲利可望翻倍
items.title_en: Foxconn Industrial Internet flags first-half profit doubling
items.summary_zh: 鴻海子公司工業富聯發布半年度業績預增公告，預估第 2 季歸屬母公司淨利為人民幣 128 億至 138 億元，年增 86% 至 101%。這份財測凸顯 AI 伺服器組裝與雲端基礎設施需求暢旺，並回饋至母公司鴻海。作為全球最大 AI 伺服器代工廠之一，工業富聯獲利爆發，反映雲端服務巨頭資本支出正轉化為電子代工鏈的超額成長，也讓市場對鴻海集團在 AI 硬體版圖的份額更具信心，成為觀察全球 AI 供應鏈景氣的重要風向球。
items.summary_en: Foxconn subsidiary Foxconn Industrial Internet (FII) issued a half-year earnings pre-announcement, projecting second-quarter net profit attributable to the parent of RMB12.8bn to RMB13.8bn, a year-on-year jump of 86% to 101%. The guidance signals booming demand for AI-server assembly and cloud infrastructure that flows back to parent Hon Hai. As one of the largest contract builders of AI servers, FII's surge underscores how hyperscaler capital spending is translating into outsized earnings growth across Taiwan's electronics manufacturing services chain.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准永豐銀併京城銀
items.title_en: FSC clears SinoPac Bank's merger with King's Town Bank
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意永豐商業銀行合併京城商業銀行，讓市場矚目的整併案順利過關。此併購將擴大永豐銀的分行網絡與存款基礎，在台灣銀行業競爭激烈、規模與數位投資日益成為勝負關鍵之際，具有壯大體質的意義。主管機關放行，顯示監理單位對有助強化資本與競爭力的整併抱持開放態度，也延續近期銀行、壽險與金控間一連串併購重塑股權版圖的趨勢，後續整併綜效與客戶、通路的整合進度將是觀察重點，牽動同業對規模化競爭的策略布局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission approved Bank SinoPac's acquisition of King's Town Bank, allowing one of the market's larger consolidations to proceed. The deal expands SinoPac's branch footprint and deposit base at a time when scale and digital investment increasingly separate winners in Taiwan's crowded banking sector. The approval reflects regulators' broader willingness to permit consolidation that strengthens capital and competitiveness, and follows a run of merger and acquisition activity reshaping the ownership map across banks, life insurers and financial holding companies.

items.title_zh: 金管會同意玉山金以股份轉換取得三商美邦人壽 100% 股權
items.title_en: FSC approves E.Sun FHC's 100% share swap for Mercuries Life
items.summary_zh: 金管會核准玉山金控以股份轉換方式取得三商美邦人壽百分之百股權，為以銀行見長的玉山金添增壽險版圖。此案讓玉山金的金融服務線更完整，橫跨銀行、證券與保險，向同業多元金控模式看齊，也是台灣壽險股權更迭浪潮中的又一重要進展。金融集團藉此追求規模化、交叉銷售綜效與跨景氣循環的穩定獲利，後續資本結構、通路整合與壽險資產負債管理如何銜接，將攸關併購綜效能否兌現，也是市場評估玉山金長線價值的關鍵。
items.summary_en: The FSC agreed to let E.Sun Financial Holding acquire 100% of Mercuries Life Insurance through a share-swap transaction, adding a life-insurance arm to a group historically strong in banking. The move gives E.Sun a fuller financial-services line-up spanning banking, securities and insurance, mirroring rivals' push toward diversified financial-holding models. It marks another significant step in the wave of insurer ownership changes sweeping Taiwan's market, as financial groups seek scale, cross-selling synergies and more stable earnings across economic cycles.

items.title_zh: 保經代五大鬆綁　最快 9 月底前上路
items.title_en: Five easing measures for insurance agents/brokers to take effect by end-September
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告修正保險經紀人、代理人管理規則，共有五大亮點，最快 9 月底前上路，包括放寬電訪對象、高齡客戶免部分錄音錄影、將境外保險（OIU）轉介費合法化等。此次修正旨在提升民眾投保便利性並推動國際保險業務，釋出對通路監理採較彈性、鼓勵成長的訊號。對保經代通路而言，鬆綁有助拓展高齡與跨境客群、活絡招攬，但如何在便利與消費者保護、防止不當招攬之間取得平衡，仍是後續執行細則與市場自律的重點，牽動保險商品銷售生態。
items.summary_en: The FSC pre-announced amendments to its insurance agent and broker management rules, with five headline changes expected to take effect as early as end-September. They include relaxing rules on tele-marketing targets, exempting elderly clients from certain audio-video recording requirements, and legalising referral fees under the offshore insurance unit (OIU) framework. The revisions aim to improve the convenience of buying insurance while advancing international insurance business, signalling a lighter-touch, growth-oriented turn in how distribution channels are regulated.

items.title_zh: 金管會檢討董事兼職兩方向　一個月內提報告
items.title_en: FSC to review director dual-role rules, disclosure report within a month
items.summary_zh: 董事兼職爭議延燒，金管會主委在立法院財委會答詢時提出兩大檢討方向：一是檢討利害關係人兼職規定是否需建立多重通報機制；二是重訊揭露制度將於一個月內提檢討報告。此議題源於金融檢查結果，反映監理單位對上市金融機構利益衝突與資訊透明度的治理要求趨嚴。若後續強化通報與揭露義務，將提高董事兼職的合規門檻與公司治理成本，也促使金融機構重新盤點關係人交易與兼職安排，牽動董事會運作與內控制度，成為公司治理與投資人保護的觀察焦點。
items.summary_en: Amid controversy over directors holding concurrent posts, the FSC chairman told lawmakers at the Legislative Yuan's finance committee that the commission will pursue two lines of review: whether related-party concurrent-post rules need a multi-layer reporting mechanism, and a re-examination of the material-information disclosure regime, with a report to be submitted within a month. The issue surfaced from financial-examination findings and reflects tightening governance expectations around conflicts of interest and transparency at listed financial institutions.

items.title_zh: 台壽攜中信投信推類全委帳戶　兼顧資產傳承與退休金流
items.title_en: Taiwan Life teams with CTBC Investments on discretionary-account policy for succession and retirement income
items.summary_zh: 中信金控子公司台灣人壽「信鑫滿滿」系列保單攜手中信投信，推出「全球領航」新臺幣類全委帳戶，鎖定台灣供應鏈與美國科技龍頭企業，透過主動與被動 ETF 靈活配置，滿足資產傳承與退休現金流雙重需求。此商品反映財管業者日益著重將投資型保險結合專業類全委操作，回應高資產客戶「傳承規劃」與「穩定金流」的雙目標。對財富管理與傳承實務而言，類全委帳戶提供彈性配置與撥回機制，有助客戶兼顧市場參與與現金流安排，也顯示保險商品正朝資產管理化、傳承工具化方向深化。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Life, a subsidiary of CTBC Financial Holding, has partnered with CTBC Investments to launch a New-Taiwan-dollar quasi-discretionary "全球領航" account within its "信鑫滿滿" insurance series. The product targets Taiwan's supply chain and leading U.S. technology companies, using a flexible mix of active and passive ETFs to serve both wealth-succession and retirement cash-flow needs. It reflects wealth-management providers' growing focus on packaging investment-linked insurance with professional discretionary management to meet high-net-worth clients' dual goals of legacy planning and steady income.

items.title_zh: 台幣優利活存年息衝 18%　遠東銀 Bankee 祭數位帳戶專案
items.title_en: Banks dangle high-yield deposits as savers turn defensive
items.summary_zh: 股市高檔震盪、投資波動加劇下，部分民眾資產配置轉趨保守，台幣存款再度成為資金停泊熱門選項，各大銀行搶攻下半年存款商機。其中遠東商銀數位帳戶品牌 Bankee 針對一定額度祭出最高年息 18% 的優惠活存，成為近期優利存款專案代表。此現象反映財管客戶在市場不確定升溫時，傾向增加現金與保守部位，也顯示存款訂價已成銀行爭取資金的前線戰場。對財富管理實務來說，優利活存雖具吸金效果，但多設有額度與條件上限，客戶仍須留意實際綜合收益與資產配置平衡。
items.summary_en: With equities choppy at high levels and market volatility rising, some investors are steering assets back toward Taiwan-dollar deposits as a safe parking spot, and banks are competing hard for that money ahead of the second half. Far Eastern International Bank's digital-account brand Bankee is offering a headline preferential demand-deposit rate of up to 18% on capped balances, part of a broader wave of promotional deposit schemes. The trend highlights how wealth clients are rebalancing toward conservative allocations, and how deposit pricing has become a front line in banks' fight for funding.

items.title_zh: 永豐 00410A 精選 AI 潛力股　主動式 ETF 搶第四波科技牛市
items.title_en: SinoPac launches AI-focused active ETF to ride the fourth tech bull wave
items.summary_zh: 台股氣勢如虹、主計總處上修台灣今年 GDP 成長估值至 9.64%，投信積極推出 AI 主題商品搶進輪動行情。永豐 00410A 主動式 ETF 定位為精選 AI 潛力股，因應台股結構轉向「AI 產業鏈輪動」——以前五月為例，電子零組件與玻璃陶瓷族群分別大漲 140% 與 99%。此檔商品反映投資人對主動管理、主題型 ETF 的興趣升溫，期望在快速輪動的 AI 行情中創造超越被動指數的報酬。對財富管理配置而言，主動式 ETF 提供選股彈性，但也考驗經理人擇時與產業輪動的判斷，客戶宜評估費用與追蹤策略。
items.summary_en: With Taiwan stocks scaling record highs and the statistics bureau lifting the island's 2026 GDP growth forecast to 9.64%, fund houses are pitching AI-themed products to capture the rotation. SinoPac's actively managed 00410A ETF is designed to select AI-potential stocks as the market structure shifts toward "AI supply-chain rotation" — in the first five months, electronic-components and glass-ceramic groups rose 140% and 99% respectively. The launch reflects rising investor appetite for actively managed, theme-driven ETFs that aim to beat passive benchmarks in a fast-rotating AI market.

items.title_zh: 青安 3.0 房屋總價分級設限　個人年所得逾 200 萬不得申貸
items.title_en: Youth Housing 3.0 to impose tiered price caps, high earners barred from loans
items.summary_zh: 青安 3.0 新制預計兩周內拍板，房屋總價上限將採三級制，超過上限不得申貸：台北市 3,500 萬元、新北市與新竹縣市 2,500 萬元、其餘縣市 2,000 萬元；個人年所得 200 萬元以上者也不得申貸。此次限縮意在把政策性優惠房貸資源導向真正的首購與中低所得族群，反映主管機關在居住負擔與信用資源集中的疑慮下，力求防杜優惠貸款遭高資產族群濫用。對房市與購屋族而言，新制將牽動可貸資格與購屋決策，也可能影響特定總價帶的交易動能，相關規範細節與上路時程值得持續關注。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's revamped Youth Housing (青安) 3.0 mortgage scheme is expected to be finalised within two weeks, introducing a three-tier ceiling on home prices above which applicants cannot borrow: NT$35m in Taipei City, NT$25m in New Taipei and Hsinchu county/city, and NT$20m elsewhere. Individuals with annual income of NT$2m or more will also be barred from applying. The tightening targets the subsidised loan programme at genuine first-home and lower-income buyers, reflecting policymakers' effort to curb misuse of preferential lending amid concerns over housing affordability and credit concentration.

items.title_zh: 所有青安房貸　8 月起補貼減碼
items.title_en: All Youth Housing mortgage subsidies to be scaled back from August
items.summary_zh: 依即將上路的規定，所有青安房貸的利息補貼將自 8 月起減碼，縮減近年支撐首購貸款的優惠力度。此舉與新增的總價分級上限、所得限制並行，顯示主管機關正對房貸政策進行整體再校準，在居住負擔目標與抑制信用過度成長、房市過熱疑慮之間求取平衡。對購屋族而言，在補貼調整前完成申貸者可望保留較優惠條件，使申請時點成為潛在買方的重要考量。整體而言，青安政策由寬轉緊的方向已明確，後續房貸市場的資格門檻與資金成本變化，將是自住與置產族的觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Under the incoming rules, the interest subsidy on all Youth Housing (青安) mortgages will be reduced starting in August, trimming the preferential support that has underpinned first-home borrowing in recent years. The pullback, alongside the new tiered price caps and income limits, signals a broader recalibration of housing-loan policy as authorities balance affordability goals against concerns over excessive credit growth and property-market froth. Borrowers who lock in before the change may retain more favourable terms, making the timing of applications a key consideration for prospective buyers.

items.title_zh: 出口連 32 紅　創最強 6 月
items.title_en: Taiwan's June exports hit strongest-ever June, up 40.3%
items.summary_zh: 財政部公布 6 月出口 748.3 億美元，是歷年最強 6 月，年增 40.3%，累計上半年出口 4,166.6 億美元、創同期新高，年增率已連 32 紅，遠勝其他主要經濟體。財政部表示，受惠 AI 風潮，台灣出口續航力十足，傳產也逐步走出外銷谷底。這份數據再度凸顯 AI 驅動的科技需求已成台灣貿易主引擎，但也讓經濟對單一景氣循環的依賴加深。展望下半年，AI 供應鏈能否維持強勁、傳產復甦力道及匯率與關稅變數，將牽動出口續航與整體經濟成長步調。
items.summary_en: The finance ministry reported June exports of US$74.83bn, the highest for any June on record and up 40.3% year-on-year, taking first-half exports to a record US$416.66bn. It marked the 32nd straight month of annual growth, far outpacing regional peers. Officials credited the AI boom for Taiwan's export staying power and noted traditional sectors are gradually emerging from an export trough. The data reinforces how AI-driven tech demand has become the primary engine of Taiwan's trade, even as it deepens the economy's reliance on a single cycle.

items.title_zh: 亞銀上修台灣今年 GDP 至 9.5%　幅度、預測值雙稱冠亞太
items.title_en: ADB lifts Taiwan's 2026 growth forecast to region-topping 9.5%
items.summary_zh: 亞洲開發銀行調升包含台灣等先進亞太經濟體今年成長率預測，並大幅上修台灣 2026 年經濟成長預估至 9.5%，稱冠亞太、調幅也居全亞太最大；台灣明年成長率仍估可達約 4%，續居昔日亞洲四小龍前段。此次上修凸顯 AI 帶動的出口與投資動能，正推升台灣寫下超乎尋常的高成長，但也引發市場對本波景氣循環成熟後能否延續的討論。對政策而言，強勁成長雖擴大財政與投資空間，卻也須留意景氣過度集中 AI、匯率與外部需求波動所帶來的下行風險。
items.summary_en: The Asian Development Bank raised its growth forecasts for advanced Asia-Pacific economies including Taiwan, sharply upgrading Taiwan's 2026 growth estimate to 9.5% — the highest in the region and the largest upward revision across Asia-Pacific. The ADB expects Taiwan's growth to still reach around 4% next year, keeping it among the strongest of the former "Asian Tigers." The upgrade underscores how AI-fuelled export and investment strength is powering an outsized expansion, while raising questions about sustainability once the current cycle matures.

items.title_zh: 楊金龍看 AI 熱提三警訊　強調產業發展沒問題
items.title_en: Central bank chief flags three AI warning signs while backing the trend
items.summary_zh: AI 浪潮持續推升台股，市場資金高度集中於 AI 概念股，也引發泡沫化疑慮。中央銀行總裁楊金龍指出，AI 產業發展方向沒有問題、具長期成長動能，真正令人擔憂的並非「產業泡沫」，而是圍繞其間的金融體系風險，包括信用與資產價格傳導。此番談話意在為市場熱度降溫，同時不否定 AI 基本面，也顯示央行正密切觀察 AI 榮景如何滲入放款、估值與金融穩定。對投資人而言，官方示警凸顯資金過度集中單一題材的系統性風險，配置上宜留意波動與槓桿累積。
items.summary_en: As the AI wave keeps lifting Taiwan stocks and concentrates capital in AI concept shares, central bank governor Yang Chin-long said the direction of the AI industry is sound and has long-term growth momentum. His real worry, he said, is not an "industry bubble" but risks building in the financial system around it — including credit and asset-price channels. The remarks aim to temper froth without dismissing AI's fundamentals, and signal the central bank is watching how AI-driven exuberance feeds into lending, valuations and financial stability.

items.title_zh: 新台幣重貶 1.46 角　收 32.178 元創逾一年低
items.title_en: Taiwan dollar slumps 1.46 jiao to 14-month low on dividend-outflow pressure
items.summary_zh: 新台幣兌美元重貶 1.46 角、收在 32.178 元，為逾一年兩個月最弱水準，主因外資股利匯出壓力浮現、且台幣多面受夾擊。此番走貶，是在去年史詩級升值之後出現，反映上市公司除息季節性資金外流疊加美元走強。台幣走弱雖有利出口報價與外銷廠商獲利，卻也墊高進口與輸入性通膨壓力，並考驗央行在物價穩定與匯率競爭力間的拿捏。後續外資動向、股利匯出節奏與美元強弱，將是判斷新台幣能否止穩的關鍵變數，牽動出口產業與資金流向。
items.summary_en: The New Taiwan dollar fell sharply by 1.46 jiao to close at 32.178 against the U.S. dollar, its weakest level in more than a year and two months, as foreign investors' dividend-repatriation pressure came to the fore and the currency faced pressure on multiple fronts. The depreciation follows a period of "epic" appreciation last year, and reflects seasonal outflows tied to listed-company dividend payouts alongside broader dollar strength. A softer local currency cushions exporters but complicates the central bank's balance between price stability and competitiveness.

items.title_zh: 美光加碼美國投資至 2,500 億美元　衝刺 AI 記憶體
items.title_en: Micron lifts U.S. investment pledge to $250bn to chase AI memory demand
items.summary_zh: 美光宣布因應 AI 時代記憶體需求持續攀升，將 2035 年前在美國投資額上調至逾 2,500 億美元，高於去年 6 月的 2,000 億美元計畫，也遠超最初規劃，將打造美國史上最大晶圓基地之一，強化先進記憶體在地生產與供應鏈韌性。這筆龐大投資顯示美光看好 AI 加速器所需的高頻寬記憶體需求將維持結構性強勁，也呼應近期記憶體超級循環題材。對台廠而言，美光擴產牽動矽晶圓、封測與設備供應鏈商機，環球晶等關係密切業者可望同步受惠。
items.summary_en: Micron announced it will invest more than US$250bn in the United States by 2035, up from the US$200bn plan unveiled last June and far above its original blueprint, as AI-era memory demand keeps climbing. The commitment underpins what is set to become one of America's largest wafer-fabrication footprints, reinforcing the reshoring of advanced memory production. The scale of the pledge signals confidence that high-bandwidth memory demand for AI accelerators will remain structurally strong for years.

items.title_zh: SK 海力士赴美 IPO 傳定價 149 美元　募資上看 265 億美元
items.title_en: SK Hynix's U.S. IPO priced near $149, raising up to $26.5bn
items.summary_zh: 據彭博報導，SK 海力士計劃將美國存託憑證（ADR）發行價訂為每單位 149 美元，較南韓普通股收盤價溢價約 3.1%，募資上看 265 億美元，規模挑戰阿里巴巴紀錄。此案獲全球長線基金、科技基金、主權財富基金及亞洲投資人踴躍認購，超額認購逾七倍，預計於那斯達克掛牌交易。這樁重量級上市案凸顯市場對 AI 記憶體龍頭的高度熱情，也帶動南亞科、華邦、旺宏等台廠記憶體族群添增比價與資金動能，成為觀察全球記憶體超級循環與資金流向的重要指標。
items.summary_en: According to Bloomberg, SK Hynix plans to price its U.S. American depositary receipts (ADRs) at US$149 each, about a 3.1% premium to its South Korean common-stock close, raising up to US$26.5bn in what would rival Alibaba's record. The offering drew orders from global long-only funds, tech funds, sovereign-wealth funds and Asian investors, and was more than seven times oversubscribed, with trading due to begin on the Nasdaq. The blockbuster listing highlights investor enthusiasm for AI-memory leaders and gives Taiwanese memory makers such as Nanya, Winbond and Macronix added momentum.

items.title_zh: 華爾街開始擔心　美股七雄熄火
items.title_en: Wall Street frets as the "Magnificent Seven" stall
items.summary_zh: 美股今年持續創高，但帶動近四年多頭的「美股七雄」卻意外缺席這波漲勢。隨 AI 熱潮推升半導體與 AI 晶片供應鏈，資金逐漸自大型科技與軟體平台股撤出，華爾街開始憂心：少了昔日領頭羊，標普 500 還衝得動嗎？這波輪動引發市場對「上漲廣度」的討論，若行情由少數族群主導、領導股基礎轉窄，指數對回檔的脆弱度恐升高。對投資人而言，須留意權值股與 AI 晶片供應鏈之間的資金輪動、以及財報季能否驗證 AI 資本支出成效，作為判斷多頭是否延續的依據。
items.summary_en: U.S. stocks keep hitting records, yet the "Magnificent Seven" mega-cap tech names that drove nearly four years of gains have surprisingly sat out this rally. As the AI craze pushes capital toward semiconductor stocks and the AI chip supply chain rather than big-cap software and platforms, Wall Street is starting to worry whether the S&P 500 can keep climbing without its former leaders. The rotation raises questions about market breadth and whether narrower leadership leaves indexes more vulnerable to a pullback.

items.title_zh: 長債重定價才剛開始　PGIM 估 30 年美債殖利率上看 5.5%
items.title_en: PGIM sees 30-year Treasury yield heading toward 5.5%
items.summary_zh: 美國 30 年期公債殖利率重返 5% 以上，市場重新評估長天期債券的合理收益率。PGIM 固定收益共同投資長 Gregory Peters 認為，長天期美債殖利率重定價才剛開始，主因 AI 投資帶動企業發債，加上美國財政部持續擴大發債，供給壓力升溫，估 30 年期殖利率上看 5.5%。此一水準將牽動房貸利率、股市估值，以及 AI 基礎設施龐大投資的融資成本。對資產配置而言，長債殖利率若續攀，將壓抑高估值成長股評價、抬高融資門檻，投資人須重新檢視存續期間與利率風險，也凸顯財政赤字與 AI 資本支出對利率的長期影響。
items.summary_en: With the U.S. 30-year Treasury yield back above 5%, investors are reassessing the fair yield on long-dated bonds. PGIM Fixed Income co-CIO Gregory Peters argues the repricing of long-maturity Treasuries has only just begun, driven by AI-related corporate bond issuance and the Treasury's continued expansion of debt supply. Peters sees the 30-year yield potentially climbing to 5.5%, a level with wide implications for mortgage rates, equity valuations and the cost of financing surging AI infrastructure spending.

items.title_zh: 韓股從全球最強墜入熊市　集中度過高才是主因
items.title_en: Korea's Kospi plunges into bear market as leveraged ETFs dominate
items.summary_zh: 南韓 Kospi 重挫約 20% 陷入熊市，分析指出真正主因並非作為導火線的 AI 股回檔，而是市場過度集中。三星電子、SK 海力士及追蹤兩者的槓桿型 ETF 合計吃掉約七成交易量，使指數對少數晶片股的漲跌高度敏感、風險集中。這波重挫，對其他科技權重偏高的市場是一記警鐘：領導股過窄、槓桿部位過度擁擠，將放大回檔的殺傷力。對投資人而言，韓股經驗凸顯分散配置與控管槓桿的重要性，也提醒 AI 行情下須慎防單一族群集中風險蔓延至整體指數。
items.summary_en: South Korea's Kospi has tumbled roughly 20% into a bear market, and analysts say the real culprit is not the AI-stock pullback that served as the trigger but the market's excessive concentration. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, together with leveraged ETFs tracking them, have come to account for around 70% of trading, leaving the index dangerously exposed to swings in a handful of chip names. The sell-off is a cautionary tale for other tech-heavy markets about the risks of narrow leadership and crowded, leveraged positioning.

items.title_zh: 晶片交易助華爾街淡化美伊最新交火
items.title_en: The Chip Trade Is Helping Wall Street Shake Off Latest Iran Strikes
items.summary_zh: 中東緊張情勢升溫，卻被市場對記憶體類股的熱情所掩蓋，投資人重新湧入 AI 記憶體交易。晶片股走強，帶動美股淡化新一輪美伊交火的衝擊，凸顯半導體題材在動盪地緣政治背景下，仍是主導市場情緒的關鍵力量。
items.summary_en: Flaring tensions in the Middle East were overshadowed by a burst of enthusiasm for the market's favourite memory stocks, as investors piled back into the AI-memory trade. The rally in chip names helped U.S. indexes look past a renewed round of U.S.–Iran fighting, underscoring how powerfully the semiconductor theme is driving sentiment even against a jittery geopolitical backdrop.

items.title_zh: 美伊交火　為和平協議以來最大規模升級
items.title_en: U.S., Iran Trade Fire in Largest Escalation Since Peace Deal
items.summary_zh: 川普宣布停火結束後，美國對伊朗發動新一輪打擊，為臨時和平協議以來最大規模的升級。川普先前承諾將展開第二晚攻擊，並警告若德黑蘭持續攻擊商船，打擊力道將加劇，為油價與全球市場帶來新的地緣政治風險。
items.summary_en: The U.S. launched new strikes on Iran after President Trump declared the ceasefire over, in the largest escalation since the interim peace deal. Trump had promised a second night of attacks and warned the strikes would worsen if Tehran keeps targeting commercial shipping, raising fresh geopolitical risk for oil and global markets.

items.title_zh: 全球石油市場尚未準備好迎接伊朗停火破局
items.title_en: The Global Oil Market Isn't Ready for the Iran Ceasefire to End
items.summary_zh: 美國原油庫存正逼近偏低的危險水位，汽油與柴油出口則接近歷史高點，一旦伊朗停火破局，全球石油市場毫無因應餘裕。供應吃緊的格局，使得若衝突再起、擾亂中東經荷莫茲海峽的原油流動，油價恐面臨劇烈飆升的風險。
items.summary_en: America's crude inventories are flirting with dangerously low levels while exports of gasoline and diesel hover near records, leaving the global oil market poorly positioned if the Iran ceasefire collapses. The tight supply picture heightens the risk of a sharp price spike should renewed conflict disrupt Middle-East flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title_zh: 中國 6 月消費者物價走弱、生產者通膨升至近四年高
items.title_en: China consumer price growth weakens in June while producer inflation nears 4-year high
items.summary_zh: 中國 6 月消費者物價增速放緩，生產者物價卻攀升至近四年高點，加深「雙速經濟」的態勢。投資人日益將中國出口強勁、內需疲弱的分歧視為長期結構特徵，使北京的政策路徑更趨複雜。
items.summary_en: China's consumer price growth softened in June even as producer inflation climbed to a near four-year high, deepening the picture of a two-speed economy. Investors increasingly see China's split between robust exports and tepid domestic demand as a defining long-term feature, complicating Beijing's policy path.

items.title_zh: 認識 SK 海力士——赴美掛牌的兆元晶片廠
items.title_en: Meet SK Hynix, the trillion-dollar chipmaker debuting on U.S. markets
items.summary_zh: 過去一年股價大漲逾七倍後，南韓 SK 海力士登陸那斯達克掛牌，鞏固其身為 AI 記憶體熱潮核心的兆元企業地位。這場備受矚目的上市，讓美國投資人能直接參與這家 AI 加速器高頻寬記憶體關鍵供應商。
items.summary_en: Following a more than sevenfold rally in its stock over the past year, South Korea's SK Hynix is listing on the Nasdaq, cementing its status as a trillion-dollar company at the heart of the AI-memory boom. The high-profile debut gives U.S. investors direct access to one of the key suppliers of high-bandwidth memory for AI accelerators.

items.title_zh: Meta 跨入 AI 編程市場　叫陣 Anthropic 與 OpenAI
items.title_en: Meta jumps into AI coding market to chase Anthropic and OpenAI
items.summary_zh: Meta 在 AI 主管 Alexandr Wang 主導下升級旗下 Muse Spark 人工智慧模型，切入 AI 編程市場，與對手 Anthropic、OpenAI 一較高下。此舉顯示程式碼生成工具競爭升溫，也反映 Meta 正將 AI 策略重新聚焦於更高價值的開發者與代理式（agentic）應用場景。
items.summary_en: Meta is upgrading its Muse Spark artificial-intelligence model under AI chief Alexandr Wang, pushing into the AI-coding market to compete with rivals Anthropic and OpenAI. The move signals intensifying competition in code-generation tools and reflects Meta's effort to reposition its AI strategy around higher-value developer and agentic use cases.

items.title_zh: 華許公布聯準會工作小組成員
items.title_en: Kevin Warsh names members of his Federal Reserve task forces
items.summary_zh: 聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）公布五個工作小組的專家名單，將檢視該機構的運作，成員包括創投家 Marc Andreessen 與沃爾瑪執行長 Doug McMillon。此一陣容顯示華許有意檢討、甚至重塑央行運作方式，並將商界與科技界要角納入其中。
items.summary_en: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh released the names of experts who will comprise five task forces examining the institution's operations, including venture capitalist Marc Andreessen and Walmart CEO Doug McMillon. The line-up signals Warsh's intent to review and potentially reshape how the central bank functions, drawing figures from business and technology into the process.

items.title_zh: Meta 股價反彈　代理式 AI 編程與自研晶片緩解支出疑慮
items.title_en: Meta's stock rebounds as agentic AI coding and custom chips ease spending fears
items.summary_zh: Meta 股價週四勁揚，因新 AI 模型推出，加上自研晶片傳出重大進展，共同緩解投資人對其龐大 AI 資本支出的疑慮。這波反彈顯示，市場更看重 AI 產品與自研晶片的實質進展，而非單純因高支出而給予懲罰。
items.summary_en: Shares of Meta rallied on Thursday after the launch of a new AI model and reports of a major custom-chip milestone, which together helped ease investor concerns over the company's heavy AI capital spending. The rebound suggests markets are rewarding tangible progress on AI products and in-house silicon rather than punishing the spending alone.

items.title_zh: Apollo 警告：AI 回報放緩恐將經濟推向衰退
items.title_en: A slower AI payoff risks tipping the economy into recession, Apollo says
items.summary_zh: Apollo 警告，AI 投資回報若不如預期，恐將經濟推向衰退，並點名來自中國的競爭威脅升高，以及 token 價格下滑可能危及 AI 公司的財務。此番示警凸顯龐大 AI 資本支出與近期回報不確定之間的落差，這股張力正日益牽動市場情緒。
items.summary_en: Apollo warns that a slower-than-expected payoff from AI investment could tip the economy toward recession, citing growing competitive threats from China and falling token prices that may put AI companies' financials at risk. The caution highlights the gap between massive AI capital spending and uncertain near-term returns, a tension increasingly weighing on markets.

items.title_zh: 帶動標普 500 走高的新族群登場
items.title_en: Meet the new group of stocks powering the S&P 500 higher
items.summary_zh: 在第二季財報季前，股市檯面下正進行一場劇烈輪動，帶動標普 500 走高的已換成一批新族群，而非長期主導的大型權值股。這一轉變意味市場領導股正在更替，也可能改變投資人為即將到來的財報季所做的布局。
items.summary_en: A violent rotation is taking place under the hood of the stock market ahead of second-quarter earnings, as a new group of stocks — rather than the long-dominant mega-cap leaders — powers the S&P 500 higher. The shift points to changing market leadership and could reshape how investors position for the coming earnings season.
